description: This file is a shell script used as part of the OpenWrt firmware upgrade framework. It defines platform-specific upgrade procedures for certain router models, managing environment variables and performing device-specific boot flags before calling a generic upgrade function.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Always returns success (0), indicating the image is acceptable.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific upgrade steps based on board name; manages environment variables and calls a default upgrade function.
